narrative.overview: This public surface explains a product workflow, then lets visitors inspect the operator's policies and open the separate merchant application. It extends the approved A composition without replacing the root ledger/W0 design system. The brief and actual rendered public pages, not the generated comp's incidental data, define this boundary.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Orange primary links use dark text; footer focus indicators use a lighter outline against slate.

dos: Do preserve locale choice, visible keyboard focus and 44px touch targets.
Do keep diagram examples separate from connection status and commercial claims.
Do read hosts and public contact details from configuration.
donts: Don't transfer this marketing composition into the merchant storefront or W0 shell.
Don't treat demo names, prices, status labels or the garment as reusable product evidence.
